propositions: The generic reads-under-sync-contention property does not subsume the original show regression test; seeds F3 and F6 (shape-valid but content-incomplete output) are caught only by the original test's ticket_id assertion

Reverting the actual slim-fetch-ledge fix (setting _RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT to 15) leaves both burst tests green; only the deterministic held-lock tests detect the regression, contradicting the burst test's protective intent

The two test oracles are complements rather than duplicates: F5/F7 faults are caught only by the generic property, while F3/F6 are caught only by the original, meeting the mutation-score criterion against removal
Consolidation is unsafe under standard test-minimization criteria (Just et al. FSE 2014); removing either test decreases the fault detection matrix
The 8-15s per-test runtime savings from consolidation is not recoverable by deletion because the original oracle's content-completeness detection is unique and live
